resources.name: career_drill_seeds
resources.declaredIntent: The secret a drill attempt's scenarios are derived from. Never leaves the server; regenerated at grading time so a client cannot answer a different question from the one it was asked.

resources.name: game_commands
resources.declaredIntent: Accepted-command idempotency ledger. A duplicate clientActionId returns the first committed response unchanged. Server-only: no API role has any privilege on this table or on the schema that contains it.

resources.name: game_state_private
resources.declaredIntent: Authoritative BlackjackGameState including future shoe order and the dealer hole card. No API role has any privilege on this table or on the schema that contains it.

resources.name: blocks
resources.declaredIntent: Directed block. Readable only by the blocker: a blocked user is never told.

resources.name: career_attempts
resources.declaredIntent: One reward-bearing attempt at one career node. Every counter is written by the server from its own authoritative state; the client reports nothing. career_progress is the aggregate computed from these.

resources.name: career_nodes
resources.declaredIntent: Public catalogue of career objectives. Written by seed data and migrations only.

resources.name: career_progress
resources.declaredIntent: Per-user career progress. Readable by its owner; every write, including reward payment, is server-controlled.

resources.name: cosmetics
resources.declaredIntent: Public cosmetic catalogue. No price column and no randomised unlock type exists by design.

resources.name: daily_challenges
resources.declaredIntent: One challenge per date. seed_secret is server-only; seed_commitment is the published SHA-256 that makes the shoe verifiable after the fact.

resources.name: daily_challenges_public
resources.declaredIntent: Client-facing projection of daily_challenges with seed_secret absent. security_invoker, so the row policy still applies.

resources.name: daily_entries
resources.declaredIntent: One attempt per user per challenge. Readable only by its owner; leaderboards are published as server-produced, public-safe output.

resources.name: friend_requests
resources.declaredIntent: Readable only by the sender and the receiver.

resources.name: friendships
resources.declaredIntent: Undirected friend edge, stored once with user_id_a < user_id_b. Created only by server code.

resources.name: game_events
resources.declaredIntent: Append-only, sanitised event stream. Participants read public rows; a seat-scoped row is readable only by its recipient.

resources.name: game_session_seats
resources.declaredIntent: Seat occupancy and table stack. Membership source for every game-scoped RLS policy.

resources.name: game_sessions
resources.declaredIntent: One table/room. Public, sanitised metadata only; the authoritative engine state lives in private.game_state_private.

resources.name: hand_players
resources.declaredIntent: One settled player hand. net = credit - wager is a database constraint.

resources.name: hand_records
resources.declaredIntent: Completed-hand archive. Dealer cards may only be stored once completed_at is set, so the hole card cannot leak through history.

resources.name: loadouts
resources.declaredIntent: Equipped cosmetics. Client-writable, but every slot is validated against ownership and kind by trigger.

resources.name: matchmaking_queue
resources.declaredIntent: Players waiting for a public seat. Allocates seats only — chips move through apply_wallet_delta in the session function, never from here.

resources.name: notifications
resources.declaredIntent: Server-written user notifications. Clients may only mark them read.

resources.name: player_actions
resources.declaredIntent: Per-decision log with optional strategy grading. Readable only by the player who made the decision.

resources.name: player_daily_xp
resources.declaredIntent: Repeatable XP earned per UTC day, for the 300/day cap. Server-written only.

resources.name: player_decision_periods
resources.declaredIntent: Server-graded basic-strategy decisions per player per ISO week. Written only by record_decisions, which is reachable by no API role. Practice, private tables and tournaments are excluded before a row is ever written.

resources.name: player_mode_stats
resources.declaredIntent: Server-written statistics bucketed by mode and ruleset version. Private to the owning user.

resources.name: player_stats
resources.declaredIntent: Server-written lifetime statistics. Private to the owning user.

resources.name: profiles
resources.declaredIntent: Public-facing player identity. level and xp are server-owned and are not client-writable.

resources.name: push_tokens
resources.declaredIntent: Per-device push registration. A user manages only their own rows.

resources.name: rate_limit_events
resources.declaredIntent: One row per ALLOWED attempt. Refusals are not recorded — see the header of this migration. Pruned on every consume, so the table holds at most one window of history per player per action.

resources.name: rate_limit_policies
resources.declaredIntent: Every rate limit in the product, in one place. Read through rate_limit_for(); never duplicated as a literal inside a function. Server-owned: no client role holds any privilege on it, and RLS is enabled with no policy, so it is unreachable through PostgREST even if a grant were added by accident.

resources.name: rooms
resources.declaredIntent: Private tables. No wallet movement is possible from here — seats use a fixed session stack, which is the anti-collusion rule, not a shortcut.

resources.name: rulesets
resources.declaredIntent: Persisted BlackjackRules values. Public read-only catalogue; written only by migrations and server code.

resources.name: tournament_entries
resources.declaredIntent: Registrations and standings. Publicly readable; created only by the server so the entry fee and the entry commit together.

resources.name: tournament_matches
resources.declaredIntent: Bracket slots. A winner must be one of the two entries in the slot.

resources.name: tournaments
resources.declaredIntent: Public tournament catalogue. Server-written.

resources.name: user_cosmetics
resources.declaredIntent: Server-granted cosmetic ownership. Readable by its owner; no client write path.

resources.name: wallet_ledger
resources.declaredIntent: Append-only chip ledger. Every row carries a unique idempotency key; UPDATE is rejected for all roles.

resources.name: wallets
resources.declaredIntent: Global virtual-chip balance. Server-authoritative: readable by its owner, writable by no client role.

controls.resource: public.apply_wallet_delta(p_user_id uuid, p_delta bigint, p_reason ledger_reason, p_idempotency_key text, p_reference_type text, p_reference_id uuid, p_metadata jsonb)
controls.controlId: public.apply_wallet_delta(p_user_id uuid, p_delta bigint, p_reason ledger_reason, p_idempotency_key text, p_reference_type text, p_reference_id uuid, p_metadata jsonb)#security_definer
controls.declaredIntent: Server-only, idempotent, row-locking chip movement. Executable by no API role — not anon, not authenticated and not service_role. Reached only as postgres, over the Edge Functions' direct database connection.

Raises if any client role holds a privilege it should not. Called at migration time — a check that runs on deploy is stronger than a test somebody may not run — and again from 20_authorization_surface.test.sql. A migration that changes a grant should call it at the bottom of the file.
Uncapped one-off XP for a tournament placement or a daily challenge reward. Not subject to the repeatable daily cap, which exists to limit grinding rather than to limit prizes. Server-only.
Restores a wallet under 2000 chips to 5000, at most once per 12 hours. Derives identity from the session and computes the amount from the locked authoritative balance — the client supplies nothing.
Records one attempt if the rolling window has room, and reports the verdict. Server-only: it names the player it charges, so no client role may reach it.

Whether this player has met the unlock condition for one cosmetic. Server-only: revoked from every client role. An unlock type it has not been taught grants nothing rather than raising, because the callers settle tournaments and career nodes inside the same transaction.

Erases the caller's account. Personal tables cascade; shared game history is anonymised, seat display names included. Hands over any lobby the caller hosts before leaving it. Refuses only while the player still holds a seat at a running table.

Consumes the caller's own budget for an action and raises PT429 — HTTP 429 through PostgREST — when it is spent. Says only how often the action may be taken and when to retry: never anything about the target of the action.
SERVER ONLY. Creates a date's challenge and mints its secret seed. Granted to no API role: the session Edge Function reaches it as postgres.
Returns today's challenge, creating it if absent and publishing the seed of any challenge that has closed. Never returns seed_secret: the projection it reads does not carry the column.

Retires rooms nobody can still use: a lobby past its 30 minutes, and a room whose game session has ended with every seat settled. Never touches a room whose session is still running — reconciling those stacks is a different job.

controls.declaredIntent: Grants every cosmetic the player has earned and not yet been given. Idempotent. Server-only; the client calls grant_earned_cosmetics() for its own account.

detail.using_expr: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR is_session_participant(game_session_id))

controls.declaredIntent: Bootstraps a profile, statistics row, funded wallet and its opening ledger entry for a new account. The requested handle is a request: it is filtered, and replaced by a derived one if it is reserved, already taken, or taken by a concurrent signup between the check and the insert.
True when the calling user holds a seat in the given session. Used by every game-scoped policy.

Enrols this player at these stakes, or returns the search already running. A matched entry whose room membership has gone, or whose room has closed, is spent rather than a reconnect, and is replaced by a fresh enrolment.

Joins a private table by code. Returns NO ROW for every reason a code does not admit you — unknown, expired, blocked, full — so a caller cannot tell a real code from a wrong one. Rate limited per rate_limit_policies.
The most recent challenge whose seed has been published, for the fairness view. Never returns a live challenge: a row is only here once revealed, and a reveal cannot happen before closes_at.

controls.resource: public.leaderboard_daily_challenge(p_date date, p_limit integer, p_offset integer)
controls.controlId: public.leaderboard_daily_challenge(p_date date, p_limit integer, p_offset integer)#execute

controls.resource: public.leaderboard_daily_challenge(p_date date, p_limit integer, p_offset integer)
controls.controlId: public.leaderboard_daily_challenge(p_date date, p_limit integer, p_offset integer)#security_definer
controls.declaredIntent: The daily board, one page at a time. Score, then accuracy, then EV lost, then submission time — the specification's order. Accuracy and EV lost come from the attempt's own graded decisions, never from the week bucket.

Cancels a waiting OR matched enrolment and releases the lobby seat of a match that was never funded. A player who has already bought in keeps their seat: the way out of a funded table is LEAVE_TABLE, which cashes them back.
The caller's own blocks. Never who blocked the caller — a block is never disclosed to the person blocked.

The caller's own live seat — game id, seat id, mode, tier, start time — or no row. Derived from auth.uid(); returns nothing about any other player and nothing from the private schema. Uses the same predicate as the server's one-live-seat control, so a player refused a second buy-in can always be told where their chips are.
The caller's own career progress, keyed by node code. Reads nothing about anybody else; auth.uid() is the only identity it will accept.

The caller's own tournament and daily-challenge totals, for the Statistics screen. Derived from auth.uid(); returns no identifier and nothing about any other player. Daily rank uses the leaderboard's own ordering, tie-breaks included, so the two cannot disagree.
The caller's own place on one board, derived from the same ordering the board uses so the two cannot disagree. Returns no row when the caller is unranked.
The caller's live sprint, or the one that finished within the last day so the result page has something to render. Never another player's.

controls.resource: public.notify_user(p_user_id uuid, p_kind notification_kind, p_title text, p_body text, p_data jsonb, p_dedupe_key text)
controls.controlId: public.notify_user(p_user_id uuid, p_kind notification_kind, p_title text, p_body text, p_data jsonb, p_dedupe_key text)#security_definer
controls.declaredIntent: The only writer of notifications. Server-only: a client cannot post itself a notification or forge one from another player.

One other player's profile as this caller may see it. Identity is returned for anybody not blocked — search_players already discloses the same three fields — while every NUMBER is governed by profiles.privacy, which Settings describes as controlling "your profile and standings". A block in either direction returns no row at all.

Allocates a public seat, or reports that the search is still running. A table with capacity is joined whether or not it has dealt; a new one is opened only when another player is already waiting at the same stakes. The candidate is confirmed under its own row lock, so a room a concurrent leave is closing is never handed out.

detail.using_expr: ((id <> ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (privacy <> 'private'::profile_privacy) AND (NOT viewer_is_blocked_by(id)) AND (NOT viewer_has_blocked(id)) AND ((privacy = 'public'::profile_privacy) OR viewer_is_friend_of(id)))

controls.declaredIntent: Every policy configured for one action, tightest window first. The only way any enforcement point learns a limit.
Counts an attempt at the moment it starts, so an abandoned run is still an attempt. Never sets status to completed and never awards a star.

controls.resource: public.record_career_completion(p_user_id uuid, p_node_id uuid, p_stars integer, p_score bigint, p_at timestamp with time zone)

controls.declaredIntent: Folds completion into best stars/score without counting the start again. Pays nothing; first-completion rewards remain ledger-backed in the Edge Function.

controls.declaredIntent: Adds a graded decision to the daily attempt owning this session. A replay has no entry row, so it silently records nothing — the same "never write" enforcement the ranked-attempt rule uses. Server-only.

controls.declaredIntent: Applies a batch of SERVER-GRADED decisions to the week bucket and the lifetime totals. Counts only — there is no parameter here through which a client could assert its own accuracy. Server-only.

controls.declaredIntent: Registers this device. An account holds at most push_tokens_per_account_maximum() registrations; the least recently used is retired rather than the new one refused.

Releases one member's room seat, migrates the host if they held it, closes the room when it empties, and cancels the matchmaking reservation that produced the seat. Server-only: the argument names somebody else's room.

Removes a member from a room LOBBY. Host only, before a game session exists, and never the host themselves. Returns false rather than raising for every refusal, so a non-host learns nothing about whether the room exists.
Closes a lobby room that has no members and no game. Server-only: the argument names somebody else's room.

Publishes the seed of every challenge whose window has closed, so the commitment published before play can actually be checked. Idempotent. Server-only: the guard trigger refuses an early reveal independently.

Finds players by exact or partial handle or display name. The query is matched as TEXT: % and _ are escaped, so the two-character minimum cannot be walked around with metacharacters. Rate-limited as player_search.
Stamps the caller's own last_seen_at. The fallback beneath ephemeral Realtime presence: called when a player publishes presence, so "last seen" means "last on the presence channel".

controls.declaredIntent: Your own entry, or an entry in a tournament you are in. Competitors must see each other's stacks and placements; nobody else may. Finished placements are published separately by leaderboard_tournament_wins.
